text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vrrrrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're on the bus to summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Japan Cup right on the
horizon, this will
be an important time
for Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Leckermaul...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it just keeps on popping into my
head.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's unsettling to say out loud...
Leckermaul...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The student sitting next to us strikes up
a
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Did you just say Leckermaul? Are you
a fan of
German fairy tales?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Huh, fairy tales? No, I... wouldn't say
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The student beside us is Eishin Flash,
who hails
from Germany.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She might know more about
"Leckermaul," which
seems to be of
German origin.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is Leckermaul a German word?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes. It is a person's name.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In the German fairy tale, "Leckermaul"
is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The name of a witch.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A witch...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The conversation takes a strange turn. I
glance
over to Agnes Tachyon, who's
sitting next to me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm, yes, I heard... but I can't say I was
listening.
Anyhow, perhaps now's a good
time...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look, Trainer, Cafe—there's something I
should
let you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I won't be having anything to do with
either of
you this summer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What? Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be a little tied up with my own plans,
you see.
They're mostly meaningless
matters, but they
can't be avoided...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Just act as if I'm not around and go
about your
business as a duo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The bus drives on, carrying all manner of

uncertainties. None of us know what to
expect at
the campgrounds.
